comparison.objective: Rotate moving cartons so labels face a fixed scanner; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception and in-place reorientation of moving parcels versus tool-mediated unlocking, rotary adjustment, relocking and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Each carton must remain upright on its carrier, be released and face the scanner at the gate; candidate requires two safe, repeatable stops.
comparison.reason: The record tests conveyor timing and orientation, not mechanical commissioning.
